controles.affirmation: Le 5 fevrier 2026, Qorvo et Skyworks ont chacun recu une Second Request de la FTC (prolonge le delai d'attente HSR)
controles.verbatim_source: On February 5, 2026, Qorvo and Skyworks each received a Request for Additional Information and Documentary Material (the "Second Request") from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission (the "FTC") in connection with the transaction. The Second Request was issued under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 (10-Q 27/06/2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune. Le glossaire precise correctement qu'une Second Request n'est pas une enquete : formulation exemplaire.

controles.affirmation: La societe est "increasingly hopeful" d'une cloture dans l'annee civile mais "there can be no assurances"
controles.verbatim_source: The Company is increasingly hopeful that the transaction will close within the calendar year, subject to satisfaction or waiver of all closing conditions, but there can be no assurances that the closing will occur on this timeline. (10-Q 27/06/2026)

controles.affirmation: Accord de fusion signe le 27 octobre 2025 : 0,960 action Skyworks + 32,50 $ cash par action Qorvo
controles.verbatim_source: On October 27, 2025, the Company entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger... (i) 0.960 (the "Exchange Ratio") shares of Skyworks common stock... and (ii) $32.50 in cash
Revenue for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 decreased 4.2%... ACG Revenue $476,569 vs $571,230, (16.6)% ; HPA $206,357 vs $137,395 ; Total revenue $784,795

controles.affirmation: Marge brute 51,1% vs 40,5% un an plus tot ; 45,9% FY2026 vs 41,3% FY2025 ; CA annuel -1,1% a 3 678,5 M$
controles.verbatim_source: Gross margin increased to 51.1% for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 as compared to 40.5% ; Gross margin for fiscal 2026 was 45.9%, compared to 41.3% in fiscal 2025 ; Revenue $3,678,517 vs $3,718,971 (1.1)%

controles.affirmation: Chine -50,6% a 77,0 M$ ; Etats-Unis +19,7% a 509,0 M$
controles.verbatim_source: United States $509,011 vs $425,260 ; China $77,012 vs $155,895 (10-Q, note 8)

controles.affirmation: Les deux plus gros clients finaux = 59% du CA FY2026 (57% et 58% les exercices precedents) ; le 10-K evoque un effet defavorable significatif
controles.verbatim_source: Collectively, our two largest end customers accounted for an aggregate of approximately 59%, 57% and 58% of our revenue for fiscal years 2026, 2025 and 2024 ; titre du facteur de risque : 'We depend on several large customers... could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations'
controles.correction_proposee: Citation exacte mais recousue : le fragment 'material adverse effect' vient du TITRE du facteur de risque, pas du corps (qui dit 'our operating results will suffer'). Citer le titre a part plutot que de le coller apres des points de suspension.

controles.affirmation: Effectifs -16,1% a 5 200 ; rachats d'actions +49,6% a 536,7 M$ ; fermeture de l'usine de Caroline du Nord
controles.verbatim_source: As of March 28, 2026, we employed approximately 5,200 full and part-time employees (6,200 dans le 10-K FY2025) ; We repurchased 6.6 million shares... for $536.7 million in fiscal 2026, compared to... $358.8 million in fiscal 2025 ; the Company decided to close its North Carolina fabrication facility
Our shareholders approved our say-on-pay proposal with only 59% of the vote. (DEF14A du 26/06/2026, resultats de l'AG 2025)

controles.affirmation: Couts lies a la fusion de 14,9 M$ sur le trimestre
controles.verbatim_source: Merger-related costs for the three months ended June 27, 2026 were approximately $14.9 million, primarily related to legal and professional fees.
